Riley Moore: Quick note 30lejandro joins Mon 6/21. Drafting a short manager+HR onboarding sprint (lean, measurable) 

Riley Moore: Pre-day (before start) checklist: order & imaging of laptop, GitHub + Slack + Okta accounts created, invite to onboarding Confluence, assign buddy (Devon), block Day1 calendar slots.

Sam Huang: HR needs I-9 & tax forms completed by Day1 EOD. Also add benefits Q&A drop-in on Day3 at 11:00.

Devon Park: Buddy plan (week1): 2x 2h pairing sessions, run dev-setup, clone `github.com/redwood/onboarding`, complete `first-pr.md` doc update, run `make test-unit`, shadow infra sync Wed 10:00.

it-ops-bot: Created ticket IT-9012 for imaging & VPN. VPN quickstart: https://internal.redwood/vpn-setup (SSO + MFA).

newhire-alejandra: Quick Q 50 will I have read access to Dedicated during week1 to follow runtime demo?

Riley Moore: Yes 50 we'll grant dedicated-readers first day, escalate PR access after manager approval on Day7. @it-ops-bot please add Alejandra to dedicated-readers.

it-ops-bot: Added Alejandra to dedicated-readers. ACL ticket ACL-2045 opened.

Sam Huang: Manager action items: send welcome intro in #eng (optional photo), confirm hardware done 48h before start, approve 30/60/90 by Day5 and post to Confluence.

Riley Moore: Sample 30/60/90 (shareable by Day4): 30d = merge first two non-doc PRs + complete onboarding tasks; 60d = own a small feature with tests; 90d = lead a minor rollout + present at retro. Make goals measurable.

Devon Park: Tip: pick a small docs or lint fix for first PR for fast feedback. I'll reserve Mon/Tue afternoons for pairing.

Riley Moore: I'll post a compact Confluence page and calendar invites tonight. Ping here if any access issues before Monday. :rocket:
